entities.summary: Giannis Theonas was a Greek politician who served as a Member of the European Parliament for the Communist Party of Greece and as a Member of the Greek Parliament for Syriza. In 2010, after his resignation from the Communist Party of Greece, he and some other politicians founded the Movement for the Unity of Action of the Left, which later merged with Syriza. He was born in Naxos.
